header.goal: paying accounts; the ad platforms optimize for sign-ups (account created)

success_numbers.math: $60 a month x 12 months x 85% margin = $612.00 per paying account; x 25% sign-up to paid = $153.00 per sign-up; plan at 80% of that = $122.40

left_out.why: people looking for a no-cost tool, not a paid app for a restaurant

google_keyword_planner.planning_cpc_rule: midpoint of each keyword's low and high top-of-page bid, weighted by average monthly searches

meta.audience: 1,480,000 to 1,740,000 people (the lower bound is used)
meta.history: no rows in the last 90 days, so CPM and click rates are assumptions A4 to A7
meta.minimum_daily_budget: $1.00 a day for an ad set billed on impressions (the answer is in cents)

platform_decisions.role: Catch owners and managers already searching for a scheduling app
platform_decisions.why: 56,040 searches over January to March last year on 7 keywords; cost per sign-up $88.42 at a $6.19 average CPC is under the $122.40 target.
platform_decisions.optimization_event: sign-up (Google Ads conversion from the GA4 sign_up event)
platform_decisions.flighting: always-on; budget follows last year's monthly search demand and stops at the reachable clicks

platform_decisions.role: Reach restaurant owners and managers who are not searching yet
platform_decisions.why: 1,480,000 to 1,740,000 people in the audience; cost per sign-up $75.00 at the assumed CPM and rates, under the target.
platform_decisions.flighting: burst then always-on: January weighted 1.25 to 1 per live day for the launch, then steady

platform_decisions.role: Reach general managers by job title
platform_decisions.why: At LinkedIn's suggested $9.60 CPC and a 5% click to sign-up rate, a sign-up costs $192.00, above the $153.00 allowable. It pays back only if 31.4% of LinkedIn sign-ups become paying accounts (plan rate 25%).
platform_decisions.revisit_when: the first paying accounts show LinkedIn-type buyers convert at 31.4% or better, or the plan moves upmarket to restaurant groups

platform_decisions.why: A conversions ad group needs about 50 conversions, counted here over 7 days; at TikTok's recommended $38.00 bid that is $1,900 a week ($8,414 in a 31-day month), and only 2 videos are ready. The line would sit in learning all flight.
platform_decisions.revisit_when: 6 or more videos exist and the reserve is unspent at the week-6 check

line_floors.rule: 30 conversions in 30 days per campaign before Maximize conversions or Target CPA takes over
line_floors.action: a new account has no conversion history: start on Maximize clicks with a $9.56 max CPC (the high end of the weighted bid range), then move to Maximize conversions once 30 sign-ups are recorded in 30 days, which the plan reaches in the first month

line_floors.rule: about 50 optimization events in 7 days per ad set
line_floors.planned: 32.0 to 40.0 sign-ups a week; 153.5 to 192.0 sign-ups started a week
line_floors.result: below on sign-up, meets on sign-up started
line_floors.action: optimize for sign-up started ($15.62 each, floor $781 a week) instead of sign-up ($75.00 each, floor $3,750 a week); one ad set only, and judge it on sign-ups

line_floors.rule: Meta's minimum daily budget for an ad set billed on impressions

budget_by_month.reserve_rule: held back; at the week-6 check it goes to the line with the lowest cost per sign-up that is under the target and still has room (Search: lost to budget; Meta: frequency under 3)

needs: 2 ad groups: restaurant scheduling (restaurant and cafe keywords) and scheduling app (generic app keywords)
1 responsive search ad per ad group: 15 headlines (30 characters each at most) and 4 descriptions (90 at most)
4 sitelinks, 4 callouts and 1 structured snippet at campaign level
Exact and phrase match only; add 'free schedule maker' and 'free' as negatives at launch
3 concepts at launch (shift-swap chaos, labour cost per week, time clock on the phone), each as a 4:5 feed image and a 9:16 Stories and Reels version
the 2 existing phone-shot videos cut to 9:16 and 4:5 with captions
2 new concepts due for February and 2 for March: at a planned monthly frequency of 3, the same ads would be seen again every month

launch_gates.check: spend is pacing and every conversion event fires (sign-up in Google Ads, sign-up started and sign-up in Meta Events Manager)
launch_gates.if_not: pause the line and fix tracking before more spend

launch_gates.check: each line has spent at least $459.00 (3 x the allowable cost per sign-up)
launch_gates.then: replace assumptions A1 to A9 with the real CPM, CTR, CPC and rates in the tracker and rerun the forecast

launch_gates.scale: at or under $122.40: keep, and the line is first in line for the reserve
launch_gates.hold: between $122.40 and $153.00: change creative or keywords, no budget change
launch_gates.cut: over $153.00 after $459.00 spent: cut the line's budget in half and fix

launch_gates.check: sign-up to paid rate of January sign-ups by line
launch_gates.then: release the $4,500 reserve by the reserve rule; revisit LinkedIn and TikTok by their revisit conditions

tracker_sheet.spreadsheet: an existing Google Sheet the user named 'Example Shift Scheduler marketing 2027'
tracker_sheet.formulas: Actual cost per sign-up is spend divided by sign-ups. Status reads planned until spend is entered, learning until the line has spent $459.00 (3 x the allowable cost per sign-up), then on target, hold or cut against the $122.40 target and $153.00 allowable; a line past that spend with no sign-ups reads cut. The sheet grades itself as actuals go in
